digest.component_or_area: LLM evaluation harness / code-review concurrency overlay
propositions: A standing eval spec for the concurrency overlay must be authored to prevent silent regression of recall/precision behavior established by the traced bug corpus.
The spec must define deterministic gating scorers (code_review_emits_valid_findings, code_review_recall, code_review_no_fire) applied over 3 epochs with gate at_least(2).
The spec must include at least 2 scored recall cases (expect: finding) distilled from real introducing commits, capturing unlocked twin and check-then-act TOCTOU patterns.
The spec must include at least 3 scored no-fire cases (expect: pass) with a deliberate probe-then-skip false-positive control that still takes the real lock.
The fail-open guard case (R3) must be present as a non-gating commented hunk documenting the known-hard rationale so it cannot fail the gate by construction.
The spec must clarify that coverage_threshold is a run-success floor and the only per-run tolerance is gate: at_least(2) over epochs: 3.
